overview: Beyond the feed, ICR's community meets in **chapters** (your city), **councils** (your subject) and **events**, and shares its working documents in the **Digital Library**. All four are behind **Discover**.

rules: A free event is yours on **Register Now**. A paid ticket is bought in your phone's browser; the app hands you over.
A full event offers the waiting list, which is free.
Some documents open only on a paid plan; the app says which plan.
You can delete a document you uploaded, from its page.
